taskRegister.Failure Mode Addressed: Bearing degradation, cavitation, seal leakage or developing misalignment
taskRegister.Maintenance Objective: Detect deterioration early and initiate corrective action before functional failure

taskRegister.Failure Mode Addressed: Bearing wear or overheating caused by lubricant degradation, contamination, under-lubrication or over-lubrication
taskRegister.Maintenance Objective: Restore the specified lubricant condition and quantity without introducing contamination

taskRegister.Failure Mode Addressed: Misalignment causing vibration, coupling wear, seal damage and bearing overload
taskRegister.Maintenance Objective: Verify and restore shaft alignment within approved cold-alignment targets

taskRegister.Applicable Make / Model: Cartridge mechanical seal – confirm seal plan
taskRegister.Failure Mode Addressed: Loss of containment from worn, damaged or incorrectly installed mechanical seal
taskRegister.Maintenance Objective: Restore leak-tight containment and verify seal support system operation

taskRegister.Failure Mode Addressed: Loss of hydraulic performance or mechanical integrity from wear, corrosion, erosion or fatigue
taskRegister.Maintenance Objective: Restore the pump to approved mechanical and hydraulic condition

operations.Detailed Work Instruction: Review recent work orders, alarms, vibration and process trends. Confirm safe access and notify Operations.
operations.Acceptance Criteria / Tolerance: Relevant history reviewed; abnormal trends identified for field confirmation.
operations.Hold Point / Decision: Escalate known critical defect before inspection.

operations.Detailed Work Instruction: Inspect casing, base, guards, fasteners, pipe supports, seal area and drains for leakage, damage, corrosion or looseness.
operations.Acceptance Criteria / Tolerance: No active hazardous leak; guards secure; no loose fasteners or damaged supports.
operations.Hold Point / Decision: Stop and make safe if loss of containment or unsafe guard is found.

operations.Detailed Work Instruction: Record suction/discharge pressure, flow if available, motor current, bearing temperatures and seal leakage.
operations.Acceptance Criteria / Tolerance: Readings within approved operating envelope and site alert limits.
operations.Hold Point / Decision: Raise defect for any limit exceedance or material change from baseline.

operations.Detailed Work Instruction: Collect repeatable vibration readings at designated bearing points and listen for cavitation, rubbing or bearing noise.
operations.Acceptance Criteria / Tolerance: Overall and spectral results within site/OEM alarm limits; no abnormal audible condition.
operations.Hold Point / Decision: Reliability review required for alert/alarm result.

operations.Detailed Work Instruction: Record condition, defects and recommended follow-on work; leave area clean.
operations.Acceptance Criteria / Tolerance: All mandatory fields completed and defects linked to notification/work request.
operations.Hold Point / Decision: Supervisor review for high-risk defect.

operations.Detailed Work Instruction: Confirm correct lubricant, quantity and interval. Shut down and isolate pump where required by site procedure.
operations.Acceptance Criteria / Tolerance: Correct lubricant confirmed; zero-energy state verified where applicable.
operations.Hold Point / Decision: Isolation verification before removing fittings or guards.

operations.Detailed Work Instruction: Clean grease nipples and inspect seals, relief paths and bearing housing for contamination or damage.
operations.Acceptance Criteria / Tolerance: Fittings clean and serviceable; no evidence of water or incompatible grease.
operations.Hold Point / Decision: Quarantine and investigate contaminated lubricant.

operations.Detailed Work Instruction: Apply OEM-specified grease slowly in the approved quantity and method. Do not mix incompatible products.
operations.Acceptance Criteria / Tolerance: Specified product and measured quantity used; purge condition acceptable.
operations.Hold Point / Decision: Stop if pressure rises abnormally or seal displacement is observed.

operations.Detailed Work Instruction: Refit caps/guards, remove isolation through approved process, run pump and check temperature, noise and leakage.
operations.Acceptance Criteria / Tolerance: Stable operation; no abnormal temperature rise, noise or leakage.
operations.Hold Point / Decision: Return to isolation if abnormal condition occurs.

operations.Detailed Work Instruction: Review alignment history and approved cold targets. Isolate motor and pump; verify zero energy.
operations.Acceptance Criteria / Tolerance: Approved target available and isolation verified.
operations.Hold Point / Decision: Formal isolation hold point.

operations.Detailed Work Instruction: Remove guard. Inspect coupling, soft foot indicators, base, hold-down bolts and pipe strain indicators.
operations.Acceptance Criteria / Tolerance: No damaged coupling element, loose base or unresolved pipe strain.
operations.Hold Point / Decision: Engineering review if base damage or pipe strain is evident.

operations.Detailed Work Instruction: Measure soft foot using approved method and correct before final alignment.
operations.Acceptance Criteria / Tolerance: Within site/OEM soft-foot tolerance.
operations.Hold Point / Decision: Do not proceed until soft foot is acceptable.

operations.Detailed Work Instruction: Install calibrated laser alignment equipment, compensate for specified thermal growth and adjust motor position.
operations.Acceptance Criteria / Tolerance: Final vertical and horizontal offset/angularity within approved target.
operations.Hold Point / Decision: Independent verification of final readings.

operations.Detailed Work Instruction: Torque hold-down bolts, recheck alignment, refit guard, de-isolate and conduct operational test.
operations.Acceptance Criteria / Tolerance: Recheck remains within tolerance; guard secure; vibration and temperature acceptable.
operations.Hold Point / Decision: Operations acceptance before return to service.

operations.Detailed Work Instruction: Confirm correct seal, elastomers, seal plan, lifting needs and OEM procedure. Conduct pre-job risk review.
operations.Acceptance Criteria / Tolerance: Parts and approved procedure match equipment configuration.
operations.Hold Point / Decision: Technical confirmation of seal selection.

operations.Detailed Work Instruction: Isolate all energy and process sources, depressurise, drain, flush and prove safe condition.
operations.Acceptance Criteria / Tolerance: Zero pressure/energy; fluid managed; atmosphere safe if applicable.
operations.Hold Point / Decision: Permit and isolation hold point.

operations.Detailed Work Instruction: Disconnect seal services, remove guard/coupling components as required and withdraw seal without damaging shaft or sleeve.
operations.Acceptance Criteria / Tolerance: Components removed safely; shaft/sleeve protected.
operations.Hold Point / Decision: Inspect unexpected damage before continuing.

operations.Detailed Work Instruction: Clean and inspect shaft/sleeve, seal chamber, gland, fits and runout as specified.
operations.Acceptance Criteria / Tolerance: Dimensions and runout within OEM limits; surfaces free from unacceptable wear.
operations.Hold Point / Decision: Engineering disposition for out-of-tolerance condition.

operations.Detailed Work Instruction: Install seal with clean components, approved lubricant and OEM setting clips/procedure. Reconnect seal plan.
operations.Acceptance Criteria / Tolerance: Seal seated correctly; fasteners torqued; setting devices removed/positioned as required.
operations.Hold Point / Decision: Independent check before coupling/guard installation.

operations.Detailed Work Instruction: Restore system, vent/prime pump, establish seal support and conduct controlled operational test.
operations.Acceptance Criteria / Tolerance: No unacceptable leakage; seal plan pressures/flows and equipment vibration/temperature acceptable.
operations.Hold Point / Decision: Operations acceptance for return to service.

operations.Detailed Work Instruction: Confirm overhaul scope, history, spares and drawings. Capture vibration, performance and alignment baseline where safe.
operations.Acceptance Criteria / Tolerance: Overhaul pack complete and baseline recorded.
operations.Hold Point / Decision: Engineering scope approval.

operations.Detailed Work Instruction: Isolate, drain, disconnect services and coupling, preserve pipework interfaces and lift pump to workshop.
operations.Acceptance Criteria / Tolerance: Pump removed without damage; openings capped; lift completed to plan.
operations.Hold Point / Decision: Isolation and lift-plan hold points.

operations.Detailed Work Instruction: Match-mark, dismantle and clean components using the OEM sequence; retain traceability.
operations.Acceptance Criteria / Tolerance: Parts identified and protected; no uncontrolled damage during disassembly.
operations.Hold Point / Decision: Witness point before destructive removal or machining.

operations.Detailed Work Instruction: NDT where specified; measure shafts, sleeves, bearings, fits, impeller, wear rings, casing, runout and clearances.
operations.Acceptance Criteria / Tolerance: All results compared with approved new/repair/reject limits.
operations.Hold Point / Decision: Engineering disposition and repair scope approval.

operations.Detailed Work Instruction: Complete approved repairs; fit bearings, wear parts, gaskets and seal; set clearances and torque fasteners.
operations.Acceptance Criteria / Tolerance: Components conform to approved limits; build data complete.
operations.Hold Point / Decision: Quality hold point before casing closure.

operations.Detailed Work Instruction: Reinstall pump, connect services without pipe strain, align driver and reinstate guards.
operations.Acceptance Criteria / Tolerance: Pipe strain acceptable; alignment within approved cold targets; guards secure.
operations.Hold Point / Decision: Independent final alignment check.

operations.Detailed Work Instruction: Prime and vent, verify rotation, start under controlled conditions, monitor performance and complete handover.
operations.Acceptance Criteria / Tolerance: No leaks or abnormal noise; pressure, flow, current, vibration and temperature meet acceptance criteria.
operations.Hold Point / Decision: Operations and engineering acceptance.

labour.Competency / Authorisation: Pump inspection and site isolation awareness
Vibration data collection and analysis Level 1 or site equivalent
labour.Support / Notes: May be completed as route-based support

labour.Competency / Authorisation: Laser shaft alignment and isolation authorisation
Mechanical seal installation, isolation and controlled bolting
labour.Support / Notes: Seal vendor support if specialist design

labour.Competency / Authorisation: Process isolation and operational test authorisation
Pump overhaul, precision measurement, rigging awareness
Inspection disposition, alignment and commissioning acceptance

materials.Kitting / Specification Notes: Use where physical defect tagging is required
Confirm base oil, thickener compatibility and exact quantity
Fit only if inspection fails acceptance criteria
Confirm metallurgy, elastomers, rotation and seal plan
Matched to pump and bearing arrangement

safetyControls.Control Requirement: Maintain exclusion from rotating parts; do not remove guards while running; use designated measurement points.
safetyControls.PPE: Site minimum plus hearing protection as required
safetyControls.Verification / Hold Point: Confirm guards secure and safe access before approach.

safetyControls.Control Requirement: Apply approved isolation where fittings/guards create exposure; use correct grease equipment and pressure.
safetyControls.PPE: Site minimum, gloves and eye protection
safetyControls.Verification / Hold Point: Prove isolation before access to hazardous points.

safetyControls.Hazard / Critical Risk: Stored energy, electrical energy and pinch points
safetyControls.Control Requirement: Full isolation; secure coupling; use controlled jacking and shim handling methods.
safetyControls.Verification / Hold Point: Isolation verification and independent alignment check.
safetyControls.Environmental Control: Collect used shims and cleaning waste.

safetyControls.Hazard / Critical Risk: Process fluid, pressure, chemical exposure and stored energy
safetyControls.Control Requirement: Isolate, depressurise, drain, flush and confirm safe atmosphere/temperature before opening containment.
safetyControls.Permit / Isolation: Process/electrical isolation; line break permit; gas test if applicable
safetyControls.Verification / Hold Point: Permit issuer verifies safe break and zero pressure.
safetyControls.Environmental Control: Capture drained product and contaminated consumables.

safetyControls.Hazard / Critical Risk: Heavy lifts, process residues, stored energy and workshop machinery
safetyControls.Control Requirement: Engineered lift plan, isolation, decontamination, certified lifting gear, machine guarding and controlled inspection methods.
safetyControls.Permit / Isolation: Isolation; lift permit/plan; line break; workshop permits as applicable
safetyControls.Verification / Hold Point: Isolation and lift hold points; engineering inspection disposition; commissioning approval.
safetyControls.Environmental Control: Manage wash water, residues, oils and replaced parts through approved waste streams.
